text: 我经历了最公开的失败
cover.source: 由成品人物截图区域重新裁切

lines: 无论你走到多高
总有一天，你都会跌倒
失败，只是生活
在把你推向另一个方向

line_sources.original_excerpt: it doesn't matter how far you might rise
at some point, you are bound to stumble ... you will at some point fall
there is no such thing as failure
failure is just life trying to move us in another direction

lines: 十九岁时，我已经开始做电视
一九八六年，我创办了自己的节目
我们登上顶峰，并在那里停留二十五年
节目连续二十一年位居同时段第一
我已经习惯了那种成功

line_sources.original_excerpt: I was on television by the time I was 19 years old
in 1986, I launched my own television show
we did make it to the top, and we stayed there for 25 years
number 1 in our time slot for 21 years
I became pretty comfortable with that level of success

lines: 但我决定重新计算人生
去寻找新的领域，开辟新的道路
于是我结束了那档节目
创办奥普拉电视网
一年后，几乎所有媒体都说它失败了

line_sources.original_excerpt: it was time to recalculate
find new territory, break new ground
I ended the show
launched OWN, the Oprah Winfrey Network
nearly every media outlet had proclaimed that my new venture was a flop

lines: 他们说，不只是失败
而是一场巨大又醒目的失败
我至今记得报纸上的嘲讽标题
那是我职业生涯最糟糕的时期
我压力巨大、沮丧，而且感到羞耻

line_sources.original_excerpt: not just a flop
a big, bold flop
I opened up USA Today and read the headline
the worst period in my professional life
I was stressed ... frustrated ... embarrassed

pages.section_title: 最难堪时收到哈佛邀请
lines: 就在那时，我接到哈佛的邀请
他们希望我为毕业生演讲
可我能对这些优秀的人说什么
偏偏那一刻
我觉得自己已经不再成功

line_sources.original_excerpt: President Faust called and asked me to speak here
you want me to speak to Harvard graduates
what could I possibly say to Harvard graduates
in the very moment
when I had stopped succeeding

lines: 那时，我以为自己困在一个深洞里
可麻烦不会永远持续
这一切也会过去
我决定把局面扭转过来
并让自己因为这次经历变得更好

line_sources.original_excerpt: I thought I was stuck in a hole
trouble don't last always
this too shall pass
I am going to turn this thing around
I will be better for it

lines: 后来，我真的扭转了那家电视网
但我也明白了一件事
无论一个人走到多高
只要还在不断提高标准、推动自己
就总会有跌倒的一天

line_sources.original_excerpt: I have turned that network around
this is what I want to share
it doesn't matter how far you might rise
raising the bar ... constantly pushing yourself higher
you will at some point fall

lines: 跌进谷底时，允许自己难过一会儿
给自己时间，悼念以为失去的东西
然后从每一个错误里学习
让经历推动你成为更完整的自己
再去寻找下一步正确的行动

line_sources.original_excerpt: it's really OK to feel bad for a little while
give yourself time to mourn what you think you may have lost
learn from every mistake
force you into being more of who you are
figure out what is the next right move
